info.title: Rumi Building Service API
info.description: REST API of the Building Management bounded context: buildings, their IoT sensors and resident invitations.

tags.name: Sensors
tags.description: IoT sensors installed in the zones of a building

tags.name: Buildings
tags.description: Registration and management of monitored buildings

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Invitation codes that let residents join a building

get.summary: List the invitations of a building
get.description: Returns the invitations generated for the building, newest first (US06). The list is empty when the building has no invitations yet.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: Identifier of the building whose invitations are listed

400.description: buildingId is missing or is not a valid UUID

post.summary: Invite a resident to a building
post.description: Generates an invitation with a unique random code for the building (US06). The invitation starts as PENDING and the administrator shares the code with the resident.

requestBody.description: Building the resident is invited to

400.description: buildingId is missing or is not a valid UUID

get.description: Returns the registered buildings ordered by name (US04). When administratorUserId is sent, only the buildings of that administrator are returned. The list is empty when nothing matches.

parameters.name: administratorUserId
parameters.description: Returns only the buildings registered by this administrator user

400.description: administratorUserId is not a valid UUID

post.description: Registers a new building to be monitored (US04). The service generates the building id and sets the status to PENDING_SENSORS; the building becomes ACTIVE when its first sensor is activated. The administrator is sent in the body until the IAM service exists.

requestBody.description: Data of the building to register

400.description: A field is missing, blank or out of range, or the body is not valid JSON

errors.floors: must be greater than or equal to 1
errors.name: must not be blank

get.summary: List the sensors of a building
get.description: Returns the sensors registered in the building, ordered by zone (US08). The list is empty when the building has no sensors yet.

400.description: buildingId is not a valid UUID

post.summary: Register a sensor in a building
post.description: Registers a sensor in one zone of the building (US08). The service generates the sensor id and the sensor starts as PENDING.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: Identifier of the building that receives the sensor

requestBody.description: Zone and type of the sensor to register

400.description: The zone is blank or too long, the type is missing or unknown, or buildingId is not a valid UUID

patch.summary: Update the status of a sensor
patch.description: Sets the sensor to PENDING, ACTIVE or INACTIVE (US08). A sensor becomes ACTIVE with its first reading; until the readings arrive by messaging, this endpoint does it by hand. When the first sensor of a building becomes ACTIVE, the building moves from PENDING_SENSORS to ACTIVE.

requestBody.description: Status to set on the sensor

400.description: The status is missing or is not PENDING, ACTIVE or INACTIVE, or sensorId is not a valid UUID

get.description: Returns one building by its identifier, including its current status (US04).

400.description: buildingId is not a valid UUID

InvitationRequest.description: Data required to invite a resident to a building

buildingId.description: Identifier of the building the resident is invited to

InvitationResponse.description: An invitation for a resident to join a building

buildingId.description: Identifier of the building the resident is invited to

code.description: Unique random code the resident enters to join the building

status.description: PENDING until the code is used; USED or EXPIRED afterwards

BuildingRequest.description: Data required to register a building

administratorUserId.description: Identifier of the administrator user who registers the building

status.description: PENDING_SENSORS until the first sensor is activated, then ACTIVE

SensorRequest.description: Data required to register a sensor in a building

zone.description: Zone of the building where the sensor is installed

SensorResponse.description: A sensor installed in a building

buildingId.description: Identifier of the building that owns the sensor

zone.description: Zone of the building where the sensor is installed

status.description: PENDING when registered, ACTIVE while it reports readings, INACTIVE when disabled
